title: Lentil Quinoa Dinner Bowl
description: A hearty vegan dinner bowl with lentils and quinoa. High in plant protein and complex carbs for muscle recovery.
instructions: Cook lentils until tender and set aside.
Cook quinoa separately according to package instructions.
Combine lentils and quinoa in a bowl with sauteed onion and spices.
Top with roasted sweet potato and serve.

title: Veggie Paneer Biryani
description: A fragrant Indian biryani with paneer and vegetables cooked in aromatic basmati rice. Rich in protein and flavor.
instructions: Marinate paneer in yogurt and spices for 15 minutes.
Cook basmati rice until 80% done.
Layer paneer and sauteed vegetables with rice in a pot.
Cover and cook on low heat for 15 minutes until fully done.

title: Chicken Tikka Masala Brown Rice
description: Classic restaurant-style chicken tikka masala served with brown rice. High protein and satisfying Indian dinner.
instructions: Marinate chicken in yogurt and tandoori spices for 15 minutes and grill.
Saute onion, garlic, and tomatoes with masala spices.
Add grilled chicken to the sauce and simmer for 10 minutes.
Serve over brown rice.

title: Beef Enchilada Bowl
description: A hearty Mexican-style beef and bean bowl with enchilada flavors. High protein and calorie-dense for athletes.
instructions: Cook ground beef with onion, cumin, and chili powder.
Add black beans and tomato sauce and simmer.
Serve over brown rice in a bowl.
Top with shredded cheese and avocado.

title: Tofu Vegetable Thai Curry
description: A fragrant Thai-style vegan tofu curry with vegetables. Rich in plant protein and coconut milk fats.
instructions: Fry tofu cubes in coconut oil until golden.
Saute onion, garlic, and curry paste in the same pan.
Add broccoli, bell pepper, and coconut milk.
Simmer for 10 minutes and serve with jasmine rice.

title: Grilled Salmon Asparagus Dinner
description: A classic grilled salmon and asparagus dinner. Loaded with omega-3s and vitamins for recovery.
instructions: Season salmon fillet with olive oil, garlic, and lemon.
Grill salmon for 5 minutes per side.
Roast broccoli and zucchini with olive oil at 200C.
Serve salmon alongside vegetables.

title: Paneer Saag with Millet
description: Creamy spinach-based paneer saag served with protein-rich millet. A nutrient-dense vegetarian Indian dinner.
instructions: Blanch and puree spinach.
Saute onion, garlic, ginger, and spices in oil.
Add paneer cubes and spinach puree and simmer.
Serve with cooked millet.

title: Chicken Thigh Cauliflower Rice Bowl
description: A low-carb chicken thigh bowl with cauliflower rice. Great for body recomposition and fat loss.
instructions: Season chicken thigh and pan-cook until done.
Grate cauliflower and stir-fry briefly as rice substitute.
Serve chicken over cauliflower rice.
Add fresh spinach and lemon on the side.

title: Tuna Pasta Primavera
description: A Mediterranean-style tuna pasta with spring vegetables. Balanced protein and carbs for active individuals.
instructions: Cook whole wheat pasta until al dente.
Saute zucchini, tomato, and garlic in olive oil.
Add drained tuna and pasta and toss together.
Season with salt, pepper, and herbs and serve.

title: Chickpea Lentil Power Salad
description: A filling vegan salad with chickpeas, lentils, and roasted vegetables. Excellent protein and fiber combination.
instructions: Cook lentils until tender and cool.
Drain and rinse chickpeas.
Roast bell pepper and zucchini with olive oil.
Toss all together with lemon dressing and serve.

title: Lamb Brown Rice Pilaf
description: A Middle Eastern-inspired lamb and brown rice pilaf with spices. Protein-dense and aromatic dinner.
instructions: Brown ground beef (lamb-style) with onion and garlic.
Add brown rice, cinnamon, cumin, and broth.
Bring to a boil and simmer covered for 25 minutes.
Fluff with a fork and serve with fresh parsley.

title: Chole Bhature
description: A classic North Indian vegetarian meal of spiced chickpeas with fried bread. High in plant protein and deeply satisfying.
instructions: Saute onion, ginger, garlic, and tomatoes with chole masala.
Add chickpeas and water and simmer for 20 minutes.
Cook roti in a pan with a small amount of oil.
Serve hot chole with roti.

title: Teriyaki Salmon Rice Bowl
description: A Japanese teriyaki salmon bowl with brown rice and edamame. Rich in omega-3s and complex carbs.
instructions: Marinate salmon in soy sauce, ginger, and honey.
Bake or pan-cook salmon for 12-15 minutes.
Cook brown rice and prepare a side of steamed broccoli.
Serve salmon over rice with broccoli.

title: Tempeh Quinoa Veggie Bowl
description: A vegan tempeh and quinoa bowl with roasted vegetables. Dense plant protein and complex carbs for muscle building.
instructions: Cook quinoa and set aside.
Pan-fry sliced tempeh until golden.
Roast sweet potato and bell pepper in olive oil.
Assemble bowl with quinoa, tempeh, and roasted vegetables.

title: Paneer Brown Rice Masala Bowl
description: A nourishing Indian vegetarian bowl with masala paneer and brown rice. High protein and fiber-rich.
instructions: Cook brown rice and set aside.
Fry paneer cubes until golden.
Saute onion, tomato, and masala spices.
Add paneer and simmer briefly, then serve over brown rice.

title: Chicken Breast Vegetable Soup
description: A light and nourishing chicken and vegetable soup. High protein and low calorie, perfect for fat loss.
instructions: Dice chicken breast and simmer in broth.
Add carrot, celery, onion, and garlic.
Cook until vegetables are tender and chicken is cooked through.
Season with salt, pepper, and fresh herbs.

title: Shrimp Fried Cauliflower Rice
description: A low-carb shrimp fried rice made with cauliflower. High protein and vegetable-rich for body recomposition.
instructions: Grate cauliflower into rice-size pieces.
Stir-fry shrimp in a wok with garlic and ginger.
Add cauliflower rice and cook for 5 minutes.
Season with soy sauce and scrambled egg bits.

title: Soy Chunk Rajma Masala
description: A protein-packed vegan combination of soy chunks and kidney beans in masala. Excellent plant protein source.
instructions: Soak and drain soy chunks.
Cook kidney beans or use canned.
Saute onion, tomato, and spices and add both proteins.
Simmer for 15 minutes and serve with brown rice.

title: Egg Fried Rice with Broccoli
description: A quick and satisfying egg fried rice with broccoli. High protein and vegetable-dense vegetarian dinner.
instructions: Heat oil in a wok and scramble eggs, then push aside.
Add cooked brown rice and stir-fry.
Add broccoli florets and cook for 3 minutes.
Season with soy sauce and sesame oil.

title: Salmon Lentil Power Plate
description: A nutrient-dense plate combining omega-3-rich salmon with lentils. Great for recovery and body recomposition.
instructions: Cook red lentils with onion and spices until thick.
Pan-sear salmon fillet in olive oil.
Serve salmon on a bed of lentils.
Add steamed spinach on the side.

title: Eggplant Chickpea Stew
description: A hearty vegan Middle Eastern stew with eggplant and chickpeas. Filling and rich in plant protein and fiber.
instructions: Cube and roast eggplant with olive oil at 200C for 15 minutes.
Saute onion and garlic, add chickpeas and tomatoes.
Add roasted eggplant and simmer for 10 minutes.
Season with cumin, coriander, and serve hot.

title: Turkey Chickpea One-Pan Dinner
description: A simple one-pan dinner with ground turkey and chickpeas. Lean protein and legume combination for athletes.
instructions: Brown turkey in a pan with olive oil and garlic.
Add chickpeas, diced tomatoes, and spices.
Simmer for 15 minutes until flavors meld.
Add spinach at the end, cook until wilted, and serve.

title: Beef Keema Quinoa Bowl
description: A hearty dinner bowl with spiced ground beef keema and quinoa. High in protein and iron for strength athletes.
instructions: Saute onion and garlic in oil.
Add ground beef with garam masala, cumin, and tomato.
Cook until beef is done and sauce thickens.
Serve over cooked quinoa with green peas.

title: Moong Dal Khichdi
description: A comforting Indian vegan one-pot meal with moong dal and rice. Easily digestible and high in plant protein.
instructions: Rinse moong dal and rice together.
Pressure cook with turmeric, cumin, and salt.
Temper with ghee (or coconut oil), mustard seeds, and curry leaves.
Serve hot with yogurt or pickle.

title: Cottage Cheese Spinach Quesadilla
description: A protein-rich vegetarian quesadilla with cottage cheese and spinach. Quick lunch with balanced macros.
instructions: Spread cottage cheese on a whole wheat tortilla.
Add fresh spinach and season with salt and chili flakes.
Fold tortilla in half and cook in a dry pan until golden.
Serve with salsa or yogurt dip.

title: Chicken Taco Salad Bowl
description: A Mexican-inspired chicken taco salad bowl with avocado and beans. High protein and fiber for body recomposition.
instructions: Season and cook chicken breast with taco spices.
Slice chicken over a bed of cabbage.
Add black beans, diced tomato, and avocado.
Drizzle with Greek yogurt and lime juice.

title: Barley Mushroom Risotto
description: A hearty vegan barley mushroom risotto with herbs. Rich in beta-glucans, fiber, and umami flavor.
instructions: Saute onion and garlic in olive oil.
Add sliced mushrooms and cook for 5 minutes.
Add barley and broth and simmer for 30 minutes stirring occasionally.
Season with thyme, salt, and fresh parsley.

title: Chicken Quinoa Greek Bowl
description: A Greek-style bowl with grilled chicken, quinoa, and cucumber-tomato salad. Balanced protein and healthy fats.
instructions: Cook quinoa and cool.
Grill chicken breast with olive oil, lemon, and oregano.
Slice chicken and serve over quinoa.
Add diced cucumber, tomato, and a dollop of Greek yogurt.

title: Smoked Mackerel Sweet Potato Mash
description: A rich dinner of smoked mackerel with sweet potato mash. High in omega-3s and beta-carotene.
instructions: Boil or microwave sweet potato until soft.
Mash with a little olive oil and season.
Flake smoked salmon onto the plate alongside mash.
Add steamed spinach on the side and serve.

title: Couscous Roasted Vegetable Salad
description: A vegan couscous salad with roasted Mediterranean vegetables. Light on calories but rich in nutrients.
instructions: Pour boiling water over couscous and leave covered for 5 minutes.
Roast bell pepper, zucchini, and cherry tomatoes with olive oil.
Fluff couscous with a fork and combine with roasted vegetables.
Dress with lemon juice, olive oil, and fresh herbs.

title: Turkey Barley Stuffed Peppers
description: Bell peppers stuffed with lean turkey and barley. A fiber-rich, protein-dense meal for body recomposition.
instructions: Halve bell peppers and remove seeds.
Cook turkey with onion, garlic, and cooked barley.
Fill peppers and bake at 190C for 25 minutes.
Serve hot with a side salad.

title: Cauliflower Chickpea Tikka
description: A bold vegan tikka with cauliflower and chickpeas in a spiced yogurt marinade. Packed with plant protein.
instructions: Marinate cauliflower florets and chickpeas in spiced tomato paste.
Roast at 220C for 20 minutes until charred.
Serve on a bed of brown rice or with roti.
Garnish with lemon juice and fresh coriander.
